## Your first fleet in four steps

<Steps>
  <Step title="Join comms">
    Join the in-game channel \[CHANNEL NAME] and the voice server at \[COMMS ADDRESS]. Your FC talks on comms for the whole fleet.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Pick a doctrine fit">
    Choose a starter fit from the [Fits page](/fits) and check your skills against it. Fly what you can fly well, not the biggest hull you can afford.
  </Step>

  <Step title="X-up on the waitlist">
    Log in with your main, link your alts, paste your fit and X-up on the [waitlist](/waitlist). The waitlist checks the fit and your skills before an FC sees you.
  </Step>

  <Step title="Wait for your invite">
    Stay docked at \[STAGING STATION] and keep comms open. Accept the fleet invite promptly, then follow your FC's positioning calls.
  </Step>
</Steps>
